push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 6.6 stings. Good. It means you care. Now let's turn that sting into a plan.

THE GOOD
+ Misplaced passes 2, down from your usual 6. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 5. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. That's growth you can count.
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.2. Do that again.

THE BAD
- No shots. Low-hanging fruit: Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on. Feet first, then flair.
- On-ball actions 15, down from your usual 39. Not who you are, but it was who showed up.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Let's turn that around by next session.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 6. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- We shipped 5 goals to YeskingFC and lost by 5. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.

THE UGLY
! Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 6.6. That's the first thing we fix, before anything else.

Practice prescription: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Small fixes, big changes. - Coach Lasso

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 3). Old coach's advice: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Steady does it.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 4. Honest truth: that cost us.
- on-ball involvement is your shared homework with buddskees: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- Match rating 6.5, down from your usual 7.9. That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.

THE UGLY

Training ground: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.

Last thing, BellyTb1. The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

One step at a time, partner. - Coach Lasso

buddskees, your 2nd worst match performance of the season with a 5.9. Every oak got rained on once.

+ Giveaways 0, down from your usual 6. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Missed tackles 0, from 3 in your previous match. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- Only 3 passes (down from your usual 24). Training homework: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark. Biscuits if you nail it.
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Key note: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Trust me on that one.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 2. Fix it like this: When you've got a clear look inside the box, pull the trigger. Hesitation lets defenders recover.
- BellyTb1 had the same on-ball involvement trouble. Team up on it: make triangles, 1-2 touch.
- We shipped 5 goals to YeskingFC and lost by 5. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

THE UGLY
! Match rating 5.9, down from your usual 8.2. Ugly is the right word. Not the only word, but the right one.

Skills corner: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Every rep counts. - Coach Lasso
